description: This file is a shell script containing test definitions and cases for testing git merge behaviors, particularly focusing on various merge scenarios such as renames, directory renames, merge conflicts, and handling of dirty (modified) working trees.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Initializes a git repository and sets up a specific merge scenario with no renames, where changes on one branch are a subset of changes on another.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expectation, runs the setup, performs merge commands, and validates outcomes.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with a rename on one branch and a modification on another to test merge behavior involving renames.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Creates a scenario with changes and renames on different branches to verify merge conflict resolution and content correctness.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Sets up a more complex scenario involving changes, renames, and expected conflicts between files.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Prepares a scenario involving directory renames and file modifications.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Prepares a scenario similar to 3a but with different rename and change combinations.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Creates a scenario with directory renames and file modifications for testing merge behaviors.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with changes on both branches and a locally modified file to test merge with dirty working tree.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Creates a scenario with renames and modifications on different branches and with local modifications to test merge conflict resolution.
